name: io.github.chinwe/compound-memory
description: Local-first shared memory for multiple AI agents that compounds with use; Markdown + git, MCP + CLI.

environmentVariables.name: COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Store root directory. A leading ~ or $HOME/${HOME} is expanded; unset or blank falls back to $HOME/.agents/memory

environmentVariables.name: COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Stable host agent id (e.g. agent-claude). Required for a multi-agent store: process identity wins over a self-reported source. Unset is only for a single trusted caller; stats.attestation.warning and the server log say so
